t: This is the home of GB News, a British free-to-air news channel on television and radio, broadcasting from studios at Paddington Basin. It was announced in September 2020 and launched in June 2021, making it Britain's first television news start-up since Sky News in 1989. It aims to offer original news, opinion and debate, and its hosts include Nigel Farage, Eamonn Holmes and Michael Portillo. Financier Sir Paul Marshall is a co-owner. He also owns The Spectator and UnHerd.
